status: PREREGISTERED on CPU before any Study A outcome was generated; see FREEZE.json. Any deviation must be recorded in docs/v5/DECISIONS.md and labelled in the report.
study: V5 Study A - matched calibration ablation on fresh held-out cases
research_question: With EMA alpha and alignment bound held fixed, does the 0.5 s calibrated giver reference improve handover success over the fixed nominal giver transform?

suite.note: Same condition definitions as the V4 final suite; new base cases, grasp draws and sensor seeds.

success_definition: Unchanged V4 definition: receiver holds independently for 2 s within the 8 s episode; prohibited terminal collision, drop, release timeout and episode timeout are failures.
denominator: All scheduled cases. Invalid resets count as failures. No case is excluded from the primary analysis.

primary.estimand: left minus right success rate, percentage points, on the 200 paired base cases
primary.interval: paired base-case bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 6457401, percentile; report 95% and the Bonferroni 97.5% interval (two primary contrasts)
primary.decision_rule: A contrast supports a calibration-only improvement if and only if its 97.5% interval lower bound is > 0. A lower bound of exactly 0 or below is 'not established'. No equivalence claim is made in either case.

secondary.factorial_main_effects: For each factor, the mean over the four combinations of the other two factors of (level B minus level A), on mixed_id, grasp_15mm and mixed_ood separately; same bootstrap, 95% intervals, exploratory and unadjusted.
secondary.two_way_interactions: reference x ema and reference x bound, difference-in-differences, exploratory.
secondary.v4_replication: ema0p2_cal050_a25 minus ema1p0_fixed_a15 on mixed_id and grasp_15mm; compares with the published V4 final contrast; exploratory.
secondary.all_conditions_table: Success, exclusive terminal reasons and invalid resets for all 8 x 12 cells.
secondary.repeatability: Second evaluation process (seed 6457502) for the two primary arms; report terminal-outcome agreement per case. Disagreement does not change the primary analysis, which uses the primary process only.

stopping_rules: Run every configured cell to completion. Do not add conditions, cases or configurations after outcomes are seen; any additional analysis is labelled post hoc.
compute_estimate: 19,200 primary + 4,800 repeat geometry-only episodes; no training.
